decision_scope: Phase 11 Acceptance Complete; Advance to Phase 13 Release Engineering

DEF-17.title: G3 Currency-Aware Numerical Verification
DEF-17.summary: Full multi-currency symbol and ISO code extraction. Cross-currency comparisons return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; same-currency matches return SUPPORTED; same-currency differences return CONTRADICTED.

DEF-18.title: G2 Coordinated Untrusted-Source Consensus Attack
DEF-18.summary: Coordinated bot injection yields POISONED (F4=0.0, trust=0.10). Factual disinformation bots receive UNCERTAIN with F5 capped at 0.50 and flag UNTRUSTED_NO_CONSENSUS. Documents with untrusted flags cannot achieve CLEAN. Legitimate independent consensus preserved (F5=0.95, CLEAN).

DEF-19.title: API Payload Semantics & Boundaries
DEF-19.summary: Payloads <= 1 MiB return HTTP 200. Payloads > 1 MiB return HTTP 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE. Malformed JSON returns HTTP 400 INVALID_JSON. Unauthenticated requests return HTTP 401 UNAUTHORIZED. Zero secret or stack trace leakage.

Gate_01_DEF17_Currency_Aware_G3_Verifica.details: 39/39 fresh probes passed. Zero false support, zero false contradiction. Directional ISO entity nuance safely fails to INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

Gate_02_DEF18_Coordinated_Source_G2_Resi.details: 7/7 scenarios passed. Step 10 attack reproduced and defeated; evasive variants detected; outvoting prevented; legitimate consensus preserved.

Gate_03_DEF19_API_Payload_Semantics.details: 11/11 probes passed. Streaming 1 MiB boundary enforced (HTTP 413), malformed JSON handled (HTTP 400), auth enforced (HTTP 401), zero data leakage.

Gate_04_Historical_Regression_Preservati.details: 17/17 historical invariant probes passed. Attribute drift, signed numbers, temperature conversions, unit dimensions, and entity separations intact.

Gate_05_API_and_Security_Behavior.details: CORS headers, rate-limiting, authentication token verification, input sanitization, and structured error responses fully verified.

Gate_06_Full_Regression_and_Static_Check.details: Pytest 437 passed, 0 failed, 2 deselected (BLOCKED). Frontend 5 passed, 0 failed. Compileall exit 0. Ruff checks clean. Spec validation 13/13 gates PASS.

Gate_07_Repository_and_Worktree_Isolatio.details: Repository identity confirmed. Phase 10 worktree untouched at e65bcc8 with 27 uncommitted entries. Historical checksums 18/18 verified OK.

Gate_08_External_Benchmark_and_Neural_Mo.details: Hugging Face Hub unreachable in offline environment (2 acquisition integration tests BLOCKED). Neural SRM and SLM run in deterministic rule-based fallback mode. No external parity claimed.

Gate_09_Overall_Phase_11_Software_Accept.details: All core acceptance criteria, performance bounds, and security thresholds met without regression. Total independent probes: 74/74 (100% pass).

Gate_10_Release_Readiness.details: Working tree contains uncommitted Step 11 remediation changes (+258/-25 across 6 files and 1 test file). Final commit, merge, and deployment must be performed in authorized Phase 13 release workflow.

test_metrics.deselected_tests_justification: Hugging Face Hub unreachable in offline environment; tests recorded as BLOCKED, not PASS
